title: Kissed Norman Jerusalem Artichoke Risotto
description: A garlicky, creamy, low‑carb risotto with Jerusalem artichokes, lemon zest, and a hint of truffle oil, served in a hot‑pot vessel.
instructions: Heat the olive oil and butter in a wide hot‑pot vessel over medium heat until foamy.
Add the diced onion and minced garlic, sautéing until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Stir in the sliced Jerusalem artichokes and cook until they begin to soften, roughly 5 minutes.
Sprinkle the arborio rice over the mixture, stirring to coat grains in oil and toast lightly for 2 minutes.
Deglaze the pot with white wine, letting it reduce until nearly evaporated.
Gradually pour in warm vegetable broth, adding one ladle at a time, stirring frequently until each addition is absorbed before adding the next.
Continue cooking, stirring for 18–20 minutes until rice is al dente and artichokes are tender, then stir in lemon zest, thyme, and grated Parmesan.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, then drizzle a small amount of truffle oil if desired and serve immediately.
